title: Quality Management in Business Central Version 28
summary: Business Central version 28 adds a native Quality Management module for inspecting goods at purchase receipt, production output, assembly output, sales returns and in ad-hoc or scheduled checks. Templates, generation rules, inspection records, result-based usage blocking and quarantine workflows are covered. The extension was not installed automatically on upgrade and had to be added from AppSource.
key_points: Inspection templates hold user-defined test codes with value types, accepted ranges and optional lookups to any table; generation rules link templates to items, vendors, customers and processes through table filters
Inspections can be created automatically on purchase receipt posting, production order finish or assembly completion, or manually for audits and complaints, by item, lot, serial or package number
Any failed line fails the whole inspection; result setup controls whether failed or pending lots, serials or packages can be sold or consumed
Workflows can move failed inventory to a chosen location or bin; the author expects standard notification responses can also be added
Certificate of Analysis, Non Conformance Report and Inspection Report printouts are available from the inspection header; the app had to be installed manually from AppSource after upgrading
